terreny, indústria i riu
/
In the past, a factory complex was the protagonist of a plot of land between fields and some small urban centres. Over decades, this area has been gradually built with varied uses, occupying green spaces that the rain had irrigated, and hiding streams that were previously part of the sonority of the urban landscape.

The small modules, fragmented and mobile, can occupy the entire space or retract discreetly, freeing up the dining room and adapting to every moment of domestic life.

46b38120797d363c06f47e8603ed94d25dd498b4:
En Pau té 24 anys, és el germà del mig i treballa com a comunicador i dissenyador en una empresa alternativa. Li encanta la seva feina, però encara més arribar a casa al final del dia i mirar com la llum de la tarda entra per la finestra, recordant-li Menorca. Té debilitat per l’estiu, les tardes llargues i l’arquitectura mediterrània.
However, what really moves him is the dance. Dancing from an early age, it's both a haven and a way to connect with the space. When she dances, everything fits: the body, the air, the silence. It is another way of communicating, more sincere than any word.

Pau is two meters high, but it is not defined. He only appreciates it when he can move freely, without running into ceilings or crossing himself with chairs. In the end, it all comes down to this: finding spaces to be himself.
/
3294d87251bf44bff7b150eeefab57a5ca2ebbab:
*línies d'aigua i arquitectura*
/
The topography configures the site as a natural open aquifer. The complex is located so that it is protected from possible flooding; the new channel is both a road and a barrier. The water collected by the roofing system is channeled through downspouts until it returns to the channel. In this way, the water cycle is closed and the footprint of the new construction is minimized.
